name: A Little Beauty
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
The Hippogryph that have taken up residence southwest of the village can be a nuisance, but they also present a rather unique opportunity to obtain their feathers. Many skyborne love to adorn their hair with vibrant plumes and the down feathers of a hippogryph are exceptionally vibrant and more importantly, silky soft.

If you are heading that way, try and gather as many of the fallen feathers as you can from in and around their nesting grounds. Do be careful, as wild hippogryph are not tolerant of guests.
narrative.objectives: Collect 8 Hippogryph Down feathers in the Shen'dar Highlands.
narrative.offerRewardText: It might seem a bit of a vain triviality, gathering feathers for our hair. However, even in times like these, one needs to embrace the small joys as much as possible.If one thing I create brings someone joy, then I will consider that to be a good day. Thank you for bringing me these and helping me bring some joy to Zephras.
narrative.requestItemsText: What beautiful things did you bring me?
